events.headline: WTI and Brent crude rise on Middle East supply worries (Brent ~$108.82, WTI ~$97.15), even as markets weigh a possible US waiver easing Russia oil/gas sanctions
Brent tops $109 after Houthi militants claim attacks on Saudi airports and Aramco facilities; Ukraine drone strikes hit Russian oil terminal/depot in St. Petersburg
ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent place over $35B in orders for Nvidia's new export-compliant RTX PRO 5500 GPU, though Nvidia warns it cannot fill full demand due to production constraints

Markets now price only ~15% odds of an October 28 Fed rate hike (down from ~70% weeks earlier) after a weak September jobs report, though Chair Warsh hasn't ruled out a surprise amid persistent inflation concerns

China's one-year pause on sweeping rare-earth export controls (agreed at the Oct 2025 Trump-Xi Busan truce) is set to expire Nov 10, 2026; outcome of renewed Trump-Xi talks on extending or easing it remains unconfirmed
